claim: Patchline ships a neuro-symbolic proof search whose every proposed proof is independently machine-checked. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the neuro-symbolic proof search claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make neuro-symbolic-proof-search-gate`.
